title: DoorDash's drone strategy started on the ground | TechCrunch
summary: DoorDash Labs, the R&D team that built its autonomous sidewalk delivery bot Dot, created the drone delivery service now called DoorDash Air. The company’s systems-first strategy for its DoorDash Air business aligns with its strengths.
